newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 8.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivorian Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan woos investors in Canada, second leg of a North American promotional tour.
- Ministers from the 11 states that own multinational carrier Air Afrique meet in Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan on Thursday to discuss the way ahead for the struggling airline.

- Privatisation of Ivorian cotton company Compagnie Ivoirienne pour le Developpement du Textile (CIDT) is imminent, privatisation of agro-industrial giant Palmindustrie marks time following the sale of some of its parts
